financing.summary: Sekisui House U.S., Inc. (SHUS, the renamed M.D.C. Holdings) is a wholly owned, voluntary SEC filer that since January 2026 holds all four Sekisui House U.S. builders (Richmond American, Woodside/Hubble, Holt, Chesmar). It funds itself with $1.5 billion of legacy MDC senior notes (nothing due before January 2030), a $1.40 billion bank revolver led by U.S. Bank ($229 million drawn at September 30, 2026, used to pay down the intercompany lines from its parent) and retained equity of $5.5 billion; the Japanese parent (S&P BBB+, JCR AA) stands behind SH Residential Holdings' bank loans. The group owns most of its land: about 38,300 owned versus 7,900 optioned lots at mid-2026 (17% optioned), close to four years of supply against a stated two-to-three-year target, and no third-party land banker is named in any filing or parent presentation reviewed. The parent's current plan calls for 'land acquisition methods to enhance ROA', working down roughly 10,000 low-margin lots, and using sister company North America Sekisui House (NASH) master-planned communities for about 5,000 lots, so the room for an outside land banker is real but would compete with an in-house affiliate and a cheap balance sheet. Net homebuilding debt to capital is only about 23% (researcher's calculation), earnings are thin (Q3 2026 net loss of $1.7 million after $42 million of California impairments), and deliveries are guided down to 9,500 for 2026.
financing.land_strategy: Owns most of its land. In its own framing (FY2025 10-K) the builders buy finished lots or develop lots as needed, often control lots through option contracts backed by cash or letter-of-credit deposits, and keep a two-to-three-year land supply; every land purchase goes to a real estate Asset Management Committee that includes two Sekisui House, Ltd. representatives. The parent's Seventh Mid-Term Management Plan (March 2026, updated September 2026) adds three land themes: 'land acquisition methods to enhance ROA', a shift of land buying from entry-level toward move-up and elite product, and a reduction of low-margin lots; it also targets 20% 'collaboration' with sister master-planned-community developer NASH (13% in the prior plan). No stated owned/optioned percentage target was found.

lots.source_title: Sekisui House, Ltd. Financial Factbook, Second Quarter of Fiscal Year 2026 (2026-09-10), p.19 U.S. homebuilding 'Inventory quantity of lots and units'
lots.note: Parent-reported figures for the whole U.S. homebuilding business at the end of its Q2 FY2026; the U.S. builders report on a calendar year, so the date is taken as June 30, 2026 (inferred from matching revenue). Same table shows end of FY2025: 40,614 owned + 11,263 optioned = 51,877 (restated to new counting criteria), plus 4,363 unsold started homes at Q2. pct_optioned and years_supply are calculated here: 46,182 lots / 11,712 homes delivered in 2025 = 3.9 years (4.9 years on the revised 2026 plan of 9,500 deliveries). Cross-checks from SHUS's own SEC filings: FY2025 10-K MD&A showed 28,728 owned + 6,488 optioned = 35,216 at 2025-12-31 for SHUS before Chesmar and Holt were contributed (West 18,191; Mountain 9,992; East 7,033) with an option purchase price of about $535 million; the Q3 2026 10-Q note shows 6,775 lots under option at 2026-09-30 with $76.4M cash and $4.0M letter-of-credit deposits at risk. The owned-lot count at 2026-09-30 sits in the 10-Q MD&A, which could not be retrieved in this run (see gaps). The parent's September 2026 presentation rounds the land position to about 50,000 lots: about 26,000 in active communities, 19,000 in inactive communities and about 5,000 NASH collaboration lots.

land_banking.counterparty: Undisclosed land sellers and developers (ordinary lot option contracts)
land_banking.description: SHUS controls lots through option contracts with third-party sellers, secured by a cash deposit or letter of credit; its exposure is generally limited to the deposit. At September 30, 2026 it had $76.4M of cash deposits and $4.0M of letters of credit at risk on options for 6,775 lots. No seller, developer or land banker is named, and the company says it is not the primary beneficiary of any option counterparty.
land_banking.source_title: Sekisui House U.S., Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (filed 2026-11-12), Commitments and Contingencies note (lot option contracts)
land_banking.note: amount_usd_m = deposits at risk (cash + letters of credit), not purchase price. Balance-sheet land option deposits were $79.3M at 2026-09-30 versus $93.9M at 2025-12-31 (prepaids note, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/773141/000077314126000019/R13.htm). At 2025-12-31, before Chesmar and Holt were added, SHUS alone had 6,488 option lots with a total purchase price of about $535M.

land_banking.description: Sister company under Sekisui House that runs the U.S. master-planned community business (about 21,300 lots held at mid-2026). The parent counts about 5,000 'NASH collaboration lots' inside the roughly 50,000-lot U.S. homebuilding land position and is pushing SHUS home sales inside NASH communities: collaboration in seven states as of March 2026, with a 20% collaboration target for FY2026 to FY2028 versus 13% in the prior plan. In effect an in-house lot pipeline that competes with outside land bankers.
land_banking.source_title: Sekisui House, Ltd. Company Presentation for Q2 FY2026 (2026-09-10), slide 'U.S. Homebuilding Business (2): Status of Land Holdings'
land_banking.note: Lot figures are the parent's rounded chart labels, read from the PDF text layer. The seven-state collaboration and 20% target are from the Seventh Mid-Term Management Plan deck (2026-03-05): https://www.sekisuihouse.co.jp/company/financial/library/ir_document/_227230/2025_kessan/p20260305e.pdf. The terms on which SHUS takes down NASH lots are not disclosed.

debt.note: principal_usd_m is the commitment. Covenants: leverage, interest coverage and tangible net worth tests (set at 60% maximum leverage, 1.50x minimum coverage and about $2.0B minimum net worth plus build-ups when signed in November 2024, per https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/773141/000077314124000052/mdc-20241119.htm). If leverage exceeds 55% a borrowing base applies, in which finished lots (70%), land under development (65%) and entitled land (50%) together may not exceed 40% of the base; change of control is defined by reference to Sekisui House, Ltd. Agent and lender names are from the 8-K and its exhibit: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/773141/000077314125000020/mdc-20251015.htm and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/773141/000077314125000020/mdc-20251015xex101.htm.

ma.counterparty: Woodside Group, LLC (Woodside Homes, including Hubble Homes) - sister company contributed by parent SH Residential Holdings
ma.description: First phase of Sekisui House's 'One Company' reorganization, announced September 4, 2025: the parent contributed Woodside (Arizona, California, Idaho, Nevada, Utah) to the former M.D.C. Holdings for no consideration. MDC had been renamed Sekisui House U.S., Inc. on September 4, 2025. Woodside's stand-alone revenue for the nine months to September 30, 2025 was $913.7M and its net assets were $994.6M.
ma.map_impact: Not a third-party deal: it moves Woodside and Hubble under the Denver holding company, so one treasury, one bank group and one Asset Management Committee now cover them. Woodside's Salt Lake City holding company and SH Services, LLC were slated to be absorbed; the parent says back-office and sales overlaps are being cut and divisions consolidated. Brands are kept 'for the time being'. Hubble Homes says it was acquired by Woodside in 2023.
ma.source_title: Sekisui House U.S., Inc. Form 8-K dated December 1, 2025 (Item 2.01)
ma.note: Announcement and schedule: Sekisui House, Ltd. notice of September 4, 2025 (https://www.sekisuihouse.co.jp/company/financial/library/ir_document/_227230/2025_kaiji/20250904-1e.pdf); name change: 8-K of September 4, 2025 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/773141/000077314125000017/mdc-20250904.htm); combined financial statements: 8-K/A of February 13, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/773141/000077314126000006/mdc-20251201.htm); Hubble ownership: https://www.hubblehomes.com/about. Accounted for as a common-control merger with results combined from April 19, 2024.

ma.counterparty: Chesmar Homes, LLC and Holt Group Holdings, LLC - sister companies contributed by parent SH Residential Holdings
ma.description: Second and final phase of the 'One Company' reorganization: the parent contributed Chesmar (Texas) and Holt (Oregon, Washington) to Sekisui House U.S., Inc. for no consideration. Their combined stand-alone revenue for the nine months to September 30, 2025 was $1.10B and net assets were $959.9M. Sekisui House, Ltd. confirmed completion on January 6, 2026.
ma.map_impact: From January 2026 all four builders report through Sekisui House U.S., Inc. In Q1 2026 the divisions were realigned into six homebuilding segments (Pacific Northwest, California, Desert, Mountain, Texas, East), so old brand-level reporting lines no longer match the org chart. Four directors joined the SHUS board on January 1, 2026 (Jennifer Whip, David Barclay, Yoshiyuki Kamiya, Shigeki Enomoto) and two left. The parent expects about $50M of annual G&A savings from closing and merging divisions and locations, so more division-level title changes are likely. The Builder 100 rank already counts the combined group (11,712 closings in 2025).
ma.source_title: Sekisui House U.S., Inc. Form 8-K dated December 31, 2025 (Items 2.01, 5.02)
ma.note: Completion notice: https://www.sekisuihouse.co.jp/company/financial/library/ir_document/2026/20260106-1e.pdf. Segment realignment: Q3 2026 10-Q segment note (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/773141/000077314126000019/R9.htm). G&A savings figure: parent presentation of September 10, 2026 (https://www.sekisuihouse.co.jp/company/financial/library/ir_document/2026/2026_kessan/p20260910e.pdf).

(Denver) -> Richmond American, Woodside/Hubble, Holt, Chesmar. SHUS has no listed equity and files with the SEC voluntarily because of its public notes; it warns it may stop filing at any time.
